description: Native Windows edge dashboard with music controls, synced lyrics, system stats, and quick controls.
notes: Astraeus is distributed as a single standalone executable; Scoop does not run an installer or install a separate runtime.

On first launch, Astraeus asks whether to start with Windows. Accepting copies the executable to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Astraeus and creates a separate Start Menu shortcut. Decline this option to keep the Scoop-managed copy as the only installation.
Application settings are stored in HKCU\Software\Astraeus and other user data under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Astraeus; these locations are managed by the application and are outside Scoop's persistence folder.
Astraeus has a built-in updater enabled by default and can replace its executable independently of Scoop. Set AutoUpdate = false in astraeus.ini when you want Scoop to manage updates.
The astraeus.ini configuration file is persisted across Scoop upgrades. The release executable is unsigned, so Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown-publisher warning.
